name: Cripple
description: A landed attack drains %stat_steal% point of every attribute and %hp_steal% maximum and current health from the target, transferring it all to this unit.
details: A further %defended_bonus% points are taken from whichever attribute the target defended with.
Against anything tougher than a basic unit every amount is multiplied by %non_basic_multiplier%.
An attack that is successfully defended still shaves %stat_steal% point off the defending attribute, but drains no health.

upgrade.summary: Takes the full toll even from an attack that fails.
details: A further %defended_bonus% points are taken from whichever attribute the target defended with.
Against anything tougher than a basic unit every amount is multiplied by %non_basic_multiplier%.
An attack that is successfully defended drains exactly as much as one that lands - every attribute, the defended bonus, and the health alike.
